beats.say: Hello! Today we will spot people who try to take over your messenger account.
All they need is the six-digit code that arrives on your phone.

messages.text: . Do not share this code with anyone.

beats.say: Never give this code to anyone: not a friend, not a colleague, not even support.
If someone asks for money in a message, call them on the phone and ask yourself.

nodes.text: A message comes from your colleague Rəna, and a minute later a Söhbət code lands on your phone. What do you do?

body.text: Hi, sorry, I sent a code to your number by mistake.
Could you please send me the six-digit code you got?

choices.label: I do not send the code, I call Rəna on the phone
choices.feedback: Correct. The code is the key to your own account, and a normal call shows whether Rəna really wrote.

choices.label: I send the code, she is a colleague after all
choices.feedback: That was the code for your account, not hers. The moment you send it, your account passes to someone else.

choices.label: I do not answer and delete the message
choices.feedback: Not giving the code is right. But Rəna's account has been stolen, so call her and let her know.

nodes.text: I sent nothing! I have not been able to get into my account since last night.
nodes.speaker: Rəna (on the phone)
nodes.spoken: I sent nothing! <breath> I have not been able to get into my account since last night.

choices.label: I tell her to log in again with her number, and we warn the work group
choices.feedback: Great. Logging in again gets the account back, and the group will not trust the fake messages.

choices.label: Nothing happened to me, so I drop it
choices.feedback: They will write to others from Rəna's account. Helping her and the group protects everyone.

nodes.text: You sent the code. Soon Söhbət logs you out, and a message asking for money goes to the group in your name.

choices.label: I log in again with my number and turn on two-step verification
choices.feedback: That is the right way to recover. Best of all, though, is never giving the code.

choices.label: I wait, maybe it will fix itself
choices.feedback: While you wait, they keep asking your friends for money. Log in again with your number right away.

scenes.title: Morning messages
scenes.intro: Several messages have arrived on your phone. Open each one and choose the right step.

steps.label: 09:12 Department group

body.text: Elnarə Hüseynova: Hello all. I urgently need 300 manat, I will pay it back tonight.
Elnarə Hüseynova: I will send the card number privately. Do not call, I am in a meeting.

steps.say: A message comes to the group from your head of department's account.

actions.label: Call Elnarə on the phone
actions.feedback: Correct. Calling the number you know shows at once who wrote the message.

actions.label: I will send it, write the card
actions.feedback: The money will go to the thief's card. An urgent money request that says do not call is a classic trick.

actions.label: Report as a fake message in the group
actions.feedback: Good step. Then call Elnarə and help her get her account back.

steps.label: 09:20 Söhbət

messages.text: Your Söhbət code: 731 064. Do not share this code with anyone.

steps.say: A Söhbət code arrived, though you did not ask for one.

actions.label: I give the code to no one
actions.feedback: Correct. If a code you did not ask for arrives, someone is trying to get into your account.

actions.label: Delete the SMS
actions.feedback: That works too. What matters is that the code goes to no one.

steps.label: 09:21 Aysel Məmmədova

body.text: Hi dear, did you get a code? I sent mine to your number by mistake.
Please send it quickly, my phone is getting blocked.

steps.say: A minute later a message comes from your friend Aysel.

actions.label: Send her the code
actions.feedback: That was the code for your account. Now your account is in the hands of whoever stole Aysel's.

actions.label: Call Aysel on the phone
actions.feedback: Correct. A code that came to you belongs to your account, and the call warns the real Aysel.

actions.label: Block
actions.feedback: Not giving the code is right. But Aysel's account has been stolen, so let her know another way.

steps.label: 09:30 Söhbət

body.text: Computer, Ganja. If this was not you, check your linked devices.

steps.say: Now Söhbət sent a notice about a new device.

actions.label: Open and remove the device
actions.feedback: Correct. Once you remove a device you do not know, it can no longer read your messages.

actions.label: Dismiss the notice
actions.feedback: That device sees all your chats. When you see a notice like this, check right away.

steps.label: 09:41 Söhbət Support

body.text: There is a suspicious login on your account and it will be blocked in one hour.
To confirm, write the code you received on your phone here.

steps.say: The last message claims to be from Söhbət support.

actions.label: Block and report
actions.feedback: Correct. Real support never asks for your code.

actions.label: Write the code
actions.feedback: Whoever writes in the name of support is a scammer. The moment you send the code, your account is theirs.

scenes.prompt: Find the signs of a trick in this message.

body.text: I will pay it back tonight.
I will send the card number privately.
Do not call, I am in a meeting.

spots.label: Urgent money
spots.explain: Rushing leaves no time to think. An urgent money request always needs checking.

spots.label: Do not call
spots.explain: Avoiding a call is the strongest sign. The thief cannot let you hear their voice, so they write.

spots.label: A private card
spots.explain: The money goes to a card you do not know. Nothing shows that this card is Elnarə's.

spots.label: A promise to repay
spots.explain: The quick repayment promise is there to calm you. Call and check first.

question.prompt: Your account has already been stolen. What is the first step?

options.label: I log in to Söhbət again with my number
options.feedback: Correct. The new code comes only to your phone, and the account returns to you.

options.label: I open a new account and forget the old one
options.feedback: The old account stays with the thief. They will keep asking your friends for money.

options.label: I write to the thief and ask for the account back
options.feedback: The thief will not give it back and may even ask for money. Log in again with your number.

scenes.explain: Log in again with your number, turn on two-step verification and warn your friends another way.

points: Never give the code to anyone, not even a friend
Check a money request with a normal phone call
If the account is gone, log in again with your number
